name: wye
description: WYE 开源物业收费管理系统：一条命令启动全栈

scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm --dir wye-server install && pnpm --dir wye-frontend install && pnpm run db:setup
scripts.db:setup: pnpm --dir wye-server db:push && pnpm --dir wye-server db:seed
scripts.db:reset: pnpm --dir wye-server db:push && pnpm --dir wye-server db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --dir wye-server dev" "pnpm --dir wye-frontend dev"
scripts.preview: pnpm run build && pnpm run start
